name: ow-eilx
description: Create render-first visual explainers that use an inline artifact or widget when available and adapt pictures, diagrams, and words to the learner.

interface.displayName: OW EILX — Explain It Like X
interface.shortDescription: Render-first visual explanations in your style
interface.longDescription: Choose a preset or describe your own style. When the host provides inline rendering, EILX uses it for a visual explainer whose pictures, diagrams, and words adapt to the audience, topic, and depth.
defaultPrompt: Explain quantum computing like I'm five.
Explain Kubernetes like a patient teacher.
Explain this like a senior engineer with diagrams.
